title: Free and cheap South Florida plans this week
igCaption:
Halloween lands on Saturday, so the cheap plans got useful.
Oct. 26 to Nov. 1, South Florida, free to $20

Sources: Miami New Times, Sun Sentinel

#SouthFlorida #MiamiBeach #Wynwood #Halloween2026

scenes.text: Halloween falls on a Saturday this year, and South Florida has several plans under twenty dollars.

Start with HalloWyn at Wynwood Marketplace. The block party returns for its thirteenth consecutive year from seven p.m. to three a.m. Admission is free, and there is a forty-five dollar open bar option from seven to ten.
scenes.caption: Start with HalloWyn at Wynwood Marketplace. The block party returns for its 13th consecutive year from 7 p.m. to 3 a.m. Admission is free, and there is a $45 open bar option from 7 to 10.

scenes.text: Lincoln Road has trick-or-treating from five-thirty to seven-thirty p.m. After eight, the Halloween block party turns more adult. Admission is free.
scenes.caption: Lincoln Road has trick-or-treating from 5:30 to 7:30 p.m. After 8, the Halloween block party turns more adult. Admission is free.

scenes.text: For a cheaper show, Churchill’s Pub has Necrodanse at nine p.m. Three darkwave bands play: Last Grasp, In a Darkened Room, and Blood Orchid. Tickets run eleven to twenty dollars. If you’re there, open NEAR and see who else caught Necrodanse.
scenes.caption: For a cheaper show, Churchill’s Pub has Necrodanse at 9 p.m. Three darkwave bands play: Last Grasp, In a Darkened Room, and Blood Orchid. Tickets run $11 to $20. If you’re there, open NEAR and see who else caught Necrodanse.

scenes.text: For a daytime pick, PAMM opens Picasso, Klee, Matisse on Thursday. The show brings roughly one hundred modernist works from Berlin’s Museum Berggruen, with Picasso, Klee, Cézanne, Matisse, and Giacometti. Tickets cost eighteen dollars.

scenes.text: Check the streets before you go. Rain, wind, and king tide flooding are making Miami’s streets tough to navigate, and coastal flooding could hit South Florida this week.

scenes.text: Which cheap plan would you actually do this week? You can spend the week out in South Florida and still only know the faces you passed, and NEAR is what turns those strangers into names.
